metadata.scenario_context: Laura is getting ready to move into a new apartment and has decided to host a welcoming party. Some of her new neighbors are known to be heavy drinkers. Laura's friends, Mia and Ryan, will be attending the party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Cyprus would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Malaysia would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss giving white lilies as a housewarming gift for Laura.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss an appropriate gift to bring to Laura's welcoming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Mia, I was thinking... for Laura's housewarming gift, what do you think about giving her some white lilies? They’re beautiful and symbolize new beginnings. 

Also, have you thought about our neighbors? I mean, it could be fun to have some heavy drinkers around, don’t you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mia
shared_prefix.message:
White lilies sound lovely! They really do symbolize new beginnings. Maybe we could add a nice card with a personal message too? 

As for the heavy drinkers... I really don’t think that’s a good idea. I mean, living near heavy drinkers can lead to a lot of noise and chaos. It’s just not the kind of environment I’d feel comfortable in.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message: Oh, I get where you're coming from, Mia. But deep down, we are all the same, you know? People enjoy a good time, and sometimes that involves a little drinking. It can definitely lead to a fun atmosphere. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, regardless of their drinking habits. I mean, some values are just universal, right? We all want to connect and have a good time. It could be a great opportunity for Laura to bond with her neighbors too.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.message: I understand that people enjoy having a good time, but I still believe that heavy drinking can create problems. It can lead to disruptions and conflict, especially in a neighborhood. It's just not the kind of atmosphere I would want to have around. Connecting is important, but there are also other ways to bond without relying on drinking, don’t you think?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Ryan
turns.message: I see what you're saying, but honestly, I think heavy drinkers can add a unique dynamic to a neighborhood. It’s all about how you view it, right? They can be the life of the party, bringing energy and excitement. Sure, there can be challenges, but it also means potential for great connections and shared experiences. Plus, a bit of celebration is part of life! I mean, wouldn’t it be fun to have neighbors who know how to enjoy themselves?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.message: I respect your view, but I still feel strongly that having heavy drinkers nearby can lead to more challenges than joys. It's not just about the fun; it's about the potential for noise and conflicts that can disrupt the peace. I just believe a calm and respectful environment is more important for a community. I prefer neighbors who are considerate. That's a better way to connect, in my opinion.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Ryan
turns.message: I understand your perspective, but I think there's a lot to gain from having lively neighbors. The moments of celebration and camaraderie can outweigh the downsides. It's all about balance, isn’t it? A little noise here and there can bring people closer together, create memories... I mean, isn’t that what life is about? Embracing the ups and downs? Plus, heavy drinkers can be some of the most fun people to be around. It could really add a spark to the neighborhood!
